title: Offline Mode Design Review
decisions: Use last-writer-wins per field with a server-side audit log for conflicts
Store offline data in SQLite on device, encrypted at rest

action_items.task: Prototype the SQLite storage layer with encryption
Add a version field to every record in the sync API
Update the design doc with the conflict resolution decision

transcript:
Priya Nair: The main open question in the design doc is conflict resolution. Option one is last-writer-wins for the whole record. Option two is per-field merging. Option three is CRDTs.
Sam Okafor: CRDTs are elegant but heavy. Our records are mostly flat forms, so per-field last-writer-wins covers nearly every real conflict.
Marcus Bell: If we go per field, the sync API needs a version on every record so the server can detect stale writes. That's about two weeks of backend work.
Priya Nair: We also need an audit trail so support can explain to a customer why a value changed.
Marcus Bell: A server-side audit log of overwritten values is cheap. Let's do that.
Sam Okafor: For on-device storage I'd use SQLite, encrypted at rest. I can prototype it in two weeks.
Priya Nair: Agreed: per-field last-writer-wins, an audit log on the server, SQLite on device. I'll update the doc.
